messages:
Iris (Design): quick sketch: 'QuickPeek' interval bar between timepicker + heatmap. Single row: p95 band, small throughput ticks, and two micro-actions: Jump (chevron) + Pin (thumbtack). Aim: instant scan -> jump. thoughts?
Theo (Frontend): Nice. Main concern: at <360px the chevron/pin overlap with scrubber controls. We should hide secondary actions behind an overflow menu in narrow widths.
Ravi (Eng Runtime): Backend ok to emit 30s aggregates and a severity flag. We'll add ?resolution=30s and sampling_ratio when data is sampled. Default to sampled for ranges > 90m.
June (Product): Ops workflow: spot a spike, jump to that interval, optionally pin for comparison. Make the Jump affordance obvious. Also surface whether data is sampled.
Sam (A11y): Accessibility nits: no hover-only reveals. Make the chevron focusable with aria-label="Jump to interval (opens timeline)" and add a visible focus ring that meets 3:1 in compact mode.
Iris (Design): UX idea: show a subtle pulsing dot on tiles with severity=critical to draw attention, but also an icon+text fallback for colorblind users. Agree on focus behavior?
Theo (Frontend): Implementation: draw base visuals on an offscreen canvas and overlay lightweight buttons (SVG) for hit targets. Will use data-interval-id attrs for analytics. Tooltips lazy-rendered.
Sam (A11y): Canvas fallback: expose an aria-live region that reads: "p50 120ms, p95 430ms, throughput 280r/s, severity: warning" when a tile receives keyboard focus. Avoid long tooltip delays for keyboard (200ms).
Ravi (Eng Runtime): For pinned intervals we'll persist up to 6 pins per user session (configurable). Response will include pinned:true and pin_id. We'll also include baseline zscore for severity derivation.
June (Product): Copy tweak: replace "Anomaly" with "Spike" in badges. Tooltip for sampled state should read: "Preview (sampled) — click to load full data".
Iris (Design): Gesture question: for touch, use longpress to reveal Pin. Sam, longpress ok for accessibility?
Sam (A11y): Longpress ok for touch, but always provide a keyboard menu entry "Pin interval". Don't rely on longpress alone. Also add shortcut hint in tooltip (Alt+J to jump).
Theo (Frontend): Will prototype a QuickPeek branch using canvas + SVG overlay. Plan to measure frame times while scrubbing.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: design-proto/quickpeek v1 -> staging at 2024-08-15T17:00Z :rocket:
Iris (Design): Action items: Theo to prototype, Sam to write accessible interaction spec + live-region copy, Ravi to add resolution & severity fields and sample flag, June to update PRD microcopy. I'll drop Figma variants by EOD. :+1:
